description:
ERECTION OF A SINGLE STOREY REAR/SIDE
EXTENSION, FOLLOWING THE DEMOLITION OF EXISTING REAR EXTENSION.
decision_conditions:
Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason:  To comply with Section 91 (as amended) of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990.

Matching Materials - The facing materials used in the development hereby permitted shall match those of the existing building in materials, style, colour, texture and, in the case of brickwork, bonding, coursing and pointing.

Reason:  To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the development and to comply with policies D12.1 and D12.3 of the Local Plan 2024.
